impact: VAL-CAP-004 requires encoder.selected backend=nvenc but encoder.probeResult shows both nvenc and libx264 as not-implemented-yet with follow_up_ticket=T-017a. The encoder.selected event is never emitted since no backend is implemented. Row will continue to fail until T-017a lands encoder selection. Blocks T-021 green verdict and T-010c gate.
resolution: Real NVENC backend implemented in T-024. Probe exercises cuInit → cuDeviceGetCount → NvEncodeAPICreateInstance → nvEncOpenEncodeSessionEx. configure/push_frame/drain/teardown produce real H.264 in fMP4 moof+mdat fragments. encoder.selected now fires for nvenc. All 139 tests pass.
title: VAL-CAP-004 encoder.selected gate fails — encoder backends report not-implemented-yet (T-017a)
